question:
**Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.**

A form of government in which power is held by the nobility
solution:
The correct answer is: **Aristocracy**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Aristocracy **is a noun that refers to a form of government in which power is held by the nobility. (अभिजात वर्ग)
 
• The word comes from the Greek words '**aristos**' meaning '**best**' and '**kratos**' meaning '**rule**'.
 
 
• **Example**: *The country's aristocracy controlled all the major decisions and policies.*
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Democracy **is a form of government in which power is held by the people or their elected representatives. (प्रजातंत्र)
 
• **Republic **is a form of government in which the people or their elected representatives hold power, rather than a monarch. (गणतंत्र)
 
• **Nobility **refers to a social class with noble rank or status, but it is not a form of government. (कुलीनता)
